cases.sentence: В тот день, когда Господь даст тебе облегчение от боли, смуты и ___, 4 ты запоешь о царе Вавилона эту язвительную песню:
cases.explain: «жестокого рабства» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

cases.explain: «облачные высоты» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

cases.explain: «другие цари» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

cases.sentence: ___ было в год смерти царя Ахаза .
cases.explain: «Следующее пророчество» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.
